description.value: A budget hostel in the heart of downtown Kelowna offering five room styles from mixed-gender dorms to private queen rooms, all with bedding included. Located on Bernard Avenue, it is a 6-minute walk to the Okanagan Lake waterfront and steps from Safeway and the Towne Centre Mall. Guests share a fully equipped self-catering kitchen, a lounge with games, and free on-site parking.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides detailed amenity information across multiple subpages. No mention of bike storage, bike handling procedures, or any cycling-specific facilities appears anywhere on the site. Laundry (washer and dryer confirmed in FAQ), Wi-Fi (confirmed on about page and in OSM tags), nearby restaurants (3-min walk confirmed on about page), and nearby Safeway (1-min walk confirmed on about page) are all supported by explicit website text.
concerns: Two different contact emails appear on the site: info@kelownaolhostel.com (front page, matches OSM) and reservations@kelownaolhostel.com (contact page). OSM carries the info@ address only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate operating hostel in a prime Okanagan cycling destination with useful amenities (laundry, kitchen, free parking, Wi-Fi), but neither secure bike storage nor staff bike procedures are mentioned anywhere on the website. Direct contact is needed to determine whether cycling-specific services exist before listing.

Laundry.detail: FAQ page lists 'washer and dryer' among available facilities

Nearby evening food.detail: About page states '3 minutes walk to premium coffee shops and various restaurants.'

Nearby grocery.detail: About page states '1 minutes walk to Safeway.'
